name: How To Dress For Church
overview: Scripture teaches that how we dress for church should reflect modesty, gender distinction, and a heart focused on honoring God rather than worldly appearance. Clothing that covers appropriately, as commanded in Exodus, and respects the distinctions between men and women, as in Deuteronomy, is essential. True beauty and favor come from a reverent fear of the Lord rather than outward adornment, while believers are called to avoid conforming to worldly fashions and instead be transformed in mind to discern God’s will. Ultimately, Christians are encouraged to judge righteously, not by outward appearance but by godly character.
